task.title: Add a CSV export button to the cart page.

record.goal: Let people export their cart as CSV

plan.brief: Add a CSV export button to the cart page.
criteria: The cart page has an Export button
The file lists each line with its price

slices.title: Export endpoint and button
acceptance: GET /cart/export.csv returns one row per line

plan.rollback: Revert the PR; nothing is stored.

cases.title: Button is visible
cases.criterion: The cart page has an Export button
cases.approach: Open /cart with two items and assert a button named Export is present; remove the feature flag and assert it is absent.

cases.title: CSV has a row per line
cases.criterion: The file lists each line with its price
cases.approach: Click Export on a cart with items A (2.50) and B (4.00); parse the download and assert exactly two rows with those prices.
